title: The host main lock's order, re-entry and land/sync holding have no test since test_autopilot_two_runners.py was deleted
goal: Tests again guard kg_lock's live behaviour that 9606015b deleted with test_autopilot_two_runners.py: taking the main lock while holding the test lock raises LockOrderError; real processes never hold the main lock at once (with a planted case that skips the lock and overlaps); a child inheriting KB_MAIN_LOCK_HELD takes no second lock; land's fetch and rebase hold it; sync --push holds it and --dry-run or sync without --push does not. kb/_self/git.md cites the new selector instead of `tests.py -k autopilot_two_runners`, which selects nothing. Found by the SP-ytfb4dc5 review.

run: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(['git','grep','-n','-E','LockOrderError','--','_tools/test_*.py'],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout+r.stderr); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 else 1)
